notes: cycleAnchorDate is a Monday that starts 'Week 1' of the printed menu. The board works out today's week by counting whole weeks since that date modulo cycleLengthWeeks, so the cycle repeats indefinitely in both directions -- it isn't limited to the Apr-Nov range the menu sheet happened to list. Desserts and the daily salad bar / fruit / jelly / milk note from the source sheet are intentionally left out here since the widget only shows Red/Green/Blue.
